**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant appears anywhere in the Agreement. I checked the planner's candidate sections (§ 30 General, § 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 26 Compliance) in full and ran targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "induce … to leave", "hire/recruit" and "personnel" — no responsive restriction exists.

Affirmatively, § 12.3 confirms Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment. That meets the preferred element ("Customer has no non-solicitation restriction"), so no redline was proposed.

Noted but not flagged: § 12.4 restrains Vendor only (no competing analytics service during the term) — a term in our favour.
